description.zh: 按住右键画一下：后退、关窗口、切标签页；选中文字后画一下或按快捷键：复制、搜索、翻译；画个圈、推到屏幕角落、在屏幕边上来回蹭、按住右键滚滚轮，都能设成按键、打开程序、输入文字或关机重启。可以只在某个程序里、某个角落里生效。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Hold the right button and draw: back, close the window, switch tabs. Select words, then draw or press a shortcut: copy, search, translate. Circles, the screen's corners and edges, and the wheel with the right button held can press keys, open programs, type text, shut down or restart. A rule can hold in one program or one corner only. Not in windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 在 Windows 10 上，手势卡片和气泡画出 1 像素的边，不再和背后的窗口混在一起（Windows 11 仍用系统的边框）；用 Win顺 0.44.0 的共用代码重新编译。权限不变。
notes.en: On Windows 10 the gesture cards and bubbles draw a 1 px edge, so they no longer blend into the window behind (Windows 11 keeps the system's border); rebuilt with WinShun 0.44.0's shared code. Permissions unchanged.
